assessments.mechanism: Use dynamic, recently sourced, objectively scored benchmark slices as an assurance layer separate from development-tuned evaluations.
assessments.clean_scope: LiveBench-style contamination-resistant general LLM benchmarking; objective ground truth does not solve open-ended agent evaluation.
assessments.uncertainty: O has not measured continuously refreshed recent-source benchmark contamination resistance.
assessments.o_comparison: O separates development/reference evidence from held-out/independent evidence and uses sealed deterministic scoring, but has no continuously refreshed LiveBench-like slice.

assessments.mechanism: Meta-evaluate judges using controlled localized interventions that create verifiable process/evidence/report failures.
assessments.clean_scope: REFLECT research-agent trace evidence; transfer outside evidence-based research-agent failures requires validation.
assessments.uncertainty: Original clean candidate predates the later v2 quantitative refinement below.
assessments.o_comparison: O fail-closes evaluator provenance and uses deterministic checks, but no controlled intervention-based meta-evaluation of an LLM judge was found.

assessments.mechanism: Attach per-instance judge reliability diagnostics using transitivity violations and calibrated/conformal prediction sets.
assessments.clean_scope: SummEval/NLG evidence; transfer to agent traces and binary/pairwise decisions is untested.
assessments.uncertainty: No O-side calibrated reliability or prediction-set study exists.
assessments.o_comparison: No conformal judge reliability, transitivity-cycle, or per-instance prediction-set mechanism was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Validate reward-model benchmarks by predictive validity for downstream Best-of-N/RL behavior, not leaderboard discrimination alone.
assessments.clean_scope: RewardBench 2; Best-of-N correlation does not guarantee PPO quality and model/distribution lineage matters.
assessments.uncertainty: O does not train/use reward models in a directly comparable loop.
assessments.o_comparison: O values downstream outcomes/protected regressions but has no reward-model benchmark or downstream RM predictive-validity study.

assessments.mechanism: Evaluate process verifiers on OOD error-localization benchmarks and compare data-efficient generative verification.
assessments.clean_scope: ProcessBench/ThinkPRM reasoning-domain evidence; broader tool-use transfer is open.
assessments.uncertainty: No comparable verifier training/evaluation exists in O.
assessments.o_comparison: No PRM/generative process-verifier training or OOD process-verifier benchmark is present.

assessments.mechanism: Use process-level supervision with active selection of informative steps when reliable intermediate labels are feasible.
assessments.clean_scope: Math reasoning with costly human step labels; strongest evidence is domain-specific.
assessments.uncertainty: Transfer to O's tool/action traces is untested.
assessments.o_comparison: O records tool events/task evaluation but does not train process reward models or actively acquire step labels.

assessments.mechanism: Audit pairwise LLM judges for order stability and model-family/self-style preference before using their outputs as signals.
assessments.clean_scope: Pairwise LLM-as-judge studies; exact mitigation gain is protocol-dependent.
assessments.uncertainty: Current clean evidence later shows bias rankings can conflict across prompt/task protocols.
assessments.o_comparison: No pairwise LLM-judge order/self-preference audit was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Evaluate uncertainty with distinct calibration and error-ranking/selective-risk objectives rather than ECE alone.
assessments.clean_scope: Black-box LLM uncertainty/scientific-QA evidence; ranking is task/format dependent.
assessments.uncertainty: O's qualitative UNCERTAIN verdict is not probabilistic calibration.
assessments.o_comparison: O has PASS/FAIL/UNCERTAIN but no calibration, abstention/selective-risk, or error-ranking benchmark.

assessments.mechanism: Meta-evaluate research-agent judges with human-validated clean-vs-localized-corruption pairs and mixed local/holistic judging.
assessments.clean_scope: REFLECT, 2026-05-18: 140 reasoning, 132 tool-use, 200 outcome perturbations (N=472), kappa 0.86. Best pointwise overall 45.7% reasoning/54.5% tool/47.5% report; fine-grained minus holistic +2.8 to +34.3pp, with some global-context failures favoring holistic judging.
assessments.uncertainty: Controlled perturbations do not exhaust natural/interactive failures; exact Best-of-N cost frontier remains unresolved.
assessments.o_comparison: O's current behavioral comparison freezes a judge/rubric and scores actual action traces, but does not meta-evaluate that judge with localized corruption pairs or mixed granularity.

assessments.mechanism: Evaluate dense step correctness plus earliest critical-error localization, preserve a neutral/exploratory label, and combine process with outcome signals for selection.
assessments.clean_scope: AgentProcessBench, 2026: 1,000 trajectories/8,509 steps/89.1% IAA; strongest 81.6% StepAcc vs 65.8% FirstErrAcc. Longest-quartile FirstErrAcc drops 10.79-21.67pp; GAIA Best-of-8 two-stage gains reach +15.0pp and error-propagation ablation is evaluator-dependent.
assessments.uncertainty: Propagation semantics and transfer to O action traces require direct ablation.
assessments.o_comparison: O records/scopes actual action traces and currently has a frozen action-adherence behavioral comparison, so a related process-evaluation submechanism exists; no earliest-error metric, neutral label, or process+outcome selector is implemented.

assessments.mechanism: Calibrate judge protocols to measured task/judge bias profiles and cost rather than applying swap/CoT/ensemble universally.
assessments.clean_scope: TMLR 2026: nine strategies, five judges, three benchmarks plus 375 controlled pairs. Style bias 0.10-0.76 while position <=0.04; best Gemini 2.5 Flash Combined Budget 71.0% agreement, kappa 0.549, ~$0.001/eval versus a 69.5% ~$0.015 frontier setup.
assessments.uncertainty: Bias rankings conflict with JudgeSense under different protocols and are measurement-design dependent.
assessments.o_comparison: O has no controlled judge-bias profile or cost-aware mitigation selector.

assessments.mechanism: Validate agent evaluators against expert-labeled trajectories across heterogeneous environments/dimensions and report precision/recall/F1 by benchmark.
assessments.clean_scope: AgentRewardBench: 1,302 trajectories/five web benchmarks/four agent LLMs; expert success IAA 89.3%. Official rules precision/recall/F1 83.8/55.9/67.1; simplified GPT-4o A11Y judge 69.8/83.1/75.9.
assessments.uncertainty: Expert labels and useful precision/recall tradeoffs are environment/use-case specific.
assessments.o_comparison: O treats evaluator validity as fallible but has no expert-labeled cross-benchmark trajectory validation with these metrics.

assessments.mechanism: Treat judge-prompt wording as a measurement variable and test verdict invariance across validated semantically equivalent paraphrases while separating order/polarity artifacts.
assessments.clean_scope: JudgeSense 2026: 494 validated paraphrase pairs; coherence JSS 0.389-0.992; factuality ~0.63 before polarity correction and ~0.9 afterward; always-A in 8/9 pairwise judges.
assessments.uncertainty: Always-A conflicts with another current-model bias study, requiring protocol reconciliation before generalization.
assessments.o_comparison: No judge-prompt equivalence/invariance suite or polarity/order artifact audit was found in O.
